scripts.build: npm run build -w @agent-console/protocol && npm run build -w @agent-console/daemon && npm run build -w @agent-console/ui && npm run build -w @agent-console/desktop
scripts.test:e2e:daemon: npm run build -w @agent-console/protocol && npm run build -w @agent-console/daemon && node scripts/e2e-daemon.mjs
scripts.test:e2e:packaged: npm run build && npm run package:dir -w @agent-console/desktop && test -x packages/desktop/dist-app/linux-unpacked/tang-agent-dashboard && E2E_EXECUTABLE=packages/desktop/dist-app/linux-unpacked/tang-agent-dashboard npm run test:e2e:desktop
scripts.ci: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run test:e2e:daemon && npm run test:e2e:desktop
scripts.desktop: npm run build && npm run start
